subject.size_in_frame: the sustained set-up, held — her face about 0.60 of frame height, unchanged from sh079

second_subject.note: still stopped, lying in her hand. No business is invented for it.

headroom: about 0.14 of frame height, identical to sh079. Nothing in the frame changes across six seconds except her thinking.
horizon_eyeline: Same axis and same values as sh079. Her eyeline is inward and unfixed through the silent beat, then comes back into focus for the line.

gaze.note: unchanged. The pause is carried by an unmoving look into an unoccupied lead room — with narration off, this empty space is the only place the un-narrated thought can live.

balance: Absolutely static and identical to sh079. The composition's refusal to develop is what makes the pause legible as thinking rather than as a gap.
leading_lines: None. By this point in the aria the frame has been reduced to a face and a horizon.
eye_first: Her eyes, and nothing else for six seconds.
constraint_binding: The pause carries the un-narrated thought and is not filled with business: no gesture, no fan movement, no water event and no reframe is placed anywhere in the shot. Dry — no music yet, and no lit element is introduced that would function as one.
pairs_with: sh078, sh079 — the same sustained set-up.
